segment.source: Lay out children of unequal heights into balanced columns.
segment.target: 將高度不一的子元素按列組織成均衡的瀑布流。

segment.source: Masonry arranges cards, images, or arbitrary controls into a shortest-column waterfall layout, with fixed or adaptive column counts and row/column gaps.
segment.target: Masonry 把卡片、圖片或任意控件按最短列策略排列成瀑布流，支援固定列數或自適應列數以及行列間距。

segment.source: Raised when the effective column assignment of children changes, dispatched after the layout pass.
segment.target: 當子項有效列分配變化時觸發，延遲到佈局週期結束後派發。

segment.source: Basic usage. Set the number of columns with ColumnCount and the spacing with ColumnGap and RowGap.
segment.target: 基礎用法展示。透過 ColumnCount 設定列數，ColumnGap 和 RowGap 設定間距。

segment.source: Use responsive values to adapt to different screen widths. ColumnInfo controls the column count at each breakpoint, and Gutter controls the spacing.
segment.target: 使用響應式參數來適配不同螢幕寬度。ColumnInfo 可以設定在不同斷點下的列數，Gutter 可以設定不同斷點下的間距大小。

segment.source: Positions are adjusted dynamically as images load.
Demonstrate how masonry layout updates dynamically. Use item.column to keep items in place.
segment.target: 展示瀑布流動態更新的效果，配合 item.column 固化位置。
